question: The final round of the _____th Senior National Football Championship for Santosh Trophy began in December 2024.
solution: The correct answer is __**78**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • The **Senior National Football Championship for Santosh Trophy** is one of India's premier football tournaments, organized under the aegis of the **All India Football Federation (AIFF)**. • The **78th edition** of the championship commenced in **December 2024**, showcasing top talent from across Indian states and union territories. • The tournament is renowned for promoting grassroots football and providing a platform for talented players to demonstrate their skills at a national level. • The championship has a rich history, with its inception dating back to **1941**, making it one of the oldest football tournaments in India. • The Santosh Trophy is contested by regional teams, representing different states and governmental institutions, fostering a sense of regional pride and competition.
